newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline continues.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline continues.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to decline as dealers found ample supplies available against declining demand.
The Midwest corn harvest, which will begin soon, plus ample pastures have lessened the need for ordering large quantities of millfeeds, dealers said.
"They (bids) are dropping further and further," said a Carolina source.
Buffalo values declined amid ample supplies and lessening demand from Pennsylvania and Carolina markets. Buffalo millfeed traded at $92 per ton for prompt shipment, down $6 from Tuesday.
Flour mills continue to operate seven days a week in many areas, providing plenty of millfeeds for feedmixers, dealers said.
Also, as corn prices edge lower ahead of harvest, feedmixers may replace millfeeds with corn in rations, they said.
